message.title: Minutes of extraordinary general meeting 2026
message.body:
Multiconsult ASA (Oslo: MULTI) has held an extraordinary general meeting today,
19 October 2026. All items on the agenda were approved as proposed, including
the merger with Rejlers AB (publ), with the following resolution:

"The merger plan dated 7 September 2026 between the Company as the transferring
company and Rejlers AB (publ) as the acquiring company is approved."

The minutes of the extraordinary general meeting, including the record of
attending shareholders and the voting protocol, are attached hereto and are also
available on the company's website.
